# Never touch the live app

`S0.1` · Coding rule

Never change Territool production. No data writes, config/deploy changes, test runs, purchases, syncs or sends against app.territool.com or live accounts. Staging or local only. Abort if a runner's host isn't staging.

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-shared|Rules for all code]].
